candidates.title: Draft a national exam schedule and room list

demandEvidence.chore: Plan and coordinate national exams, prepare exam schedules, and book rooms. A proposed mock would turn fictional operator-supplied exam dates and room constraints into a draft schedule and a list of conflicts for a coordinator to check.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Planera, administrera och samordna nationella prov Upprätta provscheman och boka lokaler

ease.reason: The notice names exam schedules and room booking; a fictional input sheet is a possible start, but no attached source supports schedule-generation mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school might value less schedule preparation; this paid staff notice does not show demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock could draft a schedule from synthetic dates and operator-set room limits; real calendars, local rules and student data are out of scope.

autonomy.reason: A draft and conflict list could repeat from supplied inputs; a coordinator must validate constraints, room suitability and all final bookings. No implementation reference is attached.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice literally names national exam coordination, schedules and room booking, but gives no frequency, constraints or software evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow fictional schedule-and-conflict-list experiment using operator-supplied dates and room limits. The notice establishes the chore, but no attached building reference supports the mechanics; real student data and final scheduling remain human work. Mean 4.6 is below threshold.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: schools may value administrative help, but the notice neither identifies a bounded problem nor establishes AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A useful two-week experiment cannot be scoped from this broad role description without inventing duties, fields or rules.

autonomy.reason: No particular repeatable loop is specified, so autonomous steps and human boundaries cannot be grounded in this evidence.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice supports a broad school administration role, not a concrete bounded chore or its frequency and constraints.

candidates.reason: The paid notice provides a broad role but no bounded chore to evaluate. I cannot define a useful experiment without inventing duties; mean 2.8 is below threshold.
